Graduate Programs
At the UofM, we offer dozens of academic majors and concentrations that are tailored
to serve your best interests to help you meet your career goals. Course delivery varies
by program, but programs are offered in traditional classroom settings, with day or
evening classes available, and online, which may be delivered synchronously or asynchronously.
